daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Cancer. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower rn. The universe is subtly nudging you toward authentic connections and meaningful moments. Lean into it.
daily.love: Someone's energy is shifting in your direction, and you're picking up on it. Whether single or coupled, today's about deepening emotional honesty. Real vulnerability hits different when you're ready for it.
daily.career: Your creative ideas have legs today. Even small projects feel significant because you're bringing genuine intention to your work. Share that vision—people are actually listening and vibing with your perspective.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slower, more intentional movement today. Maybe yoga, a walk, or just stretching while listening to music. Nourish yourself like you'd take care of someone you love.

weekly.overview: This week the cosmic energy is inviting you to lean into your intuition, Cancer. There's a quiet power building beneath the surface—trust those gut feelings that whisper before your brain catches up. Vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower rn.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, there's an invitation to get real about what you actually want. Stop performing and start feeling. Deep conversations hit different this week. Your people are craving the authentic you, not the protective shell version.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are sharper than usual. That idea you've been sitting on? Time to at least float it. You don't need permission to take up space professionally. Channel your natural ability to read rooms and lead with emotional intelligence.
